items.title: 微軟發布Windows緊急更新，移除eMudhra問題憑證的預設信任
items.summary: 印度數位憑證業者eMudhra日前發生私密金鑰安全問題，微軟於10月26日發布Windows緊急更新，從Windows預設信任清單移除6張eMudhra根憑證及1張相關交叉簽署憑證。

items.title: AI加快漏洞發現，CSA提出VulnOps模式改善企業漏洞管理
items.summary: AI加快漏洞發現速度，但企業確認漏洞影響、測試修補程式及部署更新仍需要時間。雲端安全聯盟（Cloud Security Alliance，CSA）提出VulnOps漏洞管理模式，主張企業不應只依賴定期掃描及批次修補，而應持續追蹤並處理漏洞，避免新發現的安全問題不斷累積。

items.title: 英國擬修法強化海底電纜安全，要求業者管理安全風險並通報事故
items.summary: 英國政府於10月22日公布白皮書，計畫修法強化海底關鍵基礎設施安全，提高破壞海底電纜及能源管線的刑責，並加強對海底電信基礎設施業者的安全監管。

items.title: 惡意Markdown指引檔企圖誘使Codex安裝惡意套件，AI程式開發代理面臨攻擊風險
items.summary: 資安業者Forever Security近日揭露一起利用惡意Markdown檔案攻擊AI程式開發代理的事件。研究人員在客戶電腦的下載資料夾發現惡意AGENTS.md檔案，攻擊者企圖誘使OpenAI Codex修改設定並安裝名為function-color的惡意NPM套件，但資安防護系統阻止了套件安裝。AGENTS.md是供AI程式開發代理讀取的Markdown指引檔，攻擊者將惡意指令藏入其中。

items.title: fix(ui): match canonical Unicode in place browser folder filter (#187…
items.summary: fix(ui): match canonical Unicode in place browser folder filter (#187988) fix(ui): match canonically equivalent Unicode in the place browser filter The Control UI place browser compared folder names without Unicode normalization, so typing a name in NFC missed a folder stored in NFD (common on macOS), and the reverse. The local comparison now uses lowercase NFC text, as the other Control UI filters do since #187036. Paths and exact-spelling ranking are unchanged, and selecting a result opens the folder by its original path. Evidence: built Control UI served by a built Gateway in real Chromium, with real folders on disk. On main, NFC "CAFÉ" against an NFD folder and NFD "Résumé" against an NFC folder both found nothing (twice); with this change both matched (twice), and clicking the result opened the original NFD path, confirmed by code-point readback. ASCII matches and non-matches are unchanged. Screenshots and details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187988#issuecomment-6512602191. Thanks @huwei-xydt. Co-authored-by: Claude Code Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
